sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Try RIGHT
result = action(['RIGHT'])
print(f"After RIGHT: level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}, done={result.get('done')}, board_changed={result.get('board_changed')}, no_impact={result.get('no_impact')}")

# Check player position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
player = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'b':
        player = n
        break
if player:
    p_center = (sum(p[0] for p in player['boundary'])//len(player['boundary']), sum(p[1] for p in player['boundary'])//len(player['boundary']))
    print(f"Player at: {p_center}")
    
    # Check adjacencies
    adj_info = []
    for adj in seg['adjacency_list']:
        if adj[0] == player['id'] or adj[1] == player['id']:
            other_id = adj[1] if adj[0] == player['id'] else adj[0]
            other = next(x for x in seg['nodes'] if x['id'] == other_id)
            o_center = (sum(p[0] for p in other['boundary'])//len(other['boundary']), sum(p[1] for p in other['boundary'])//len(other['boundary']))
            dr = o_center[0] - p_center[0]
            dc = o_center[1] - p_center[1]
            direction = ''
            if dr < 0: direction = 'UP'
            elif dr > 0: direction = 'DOWN'
            elif dc < 0: direction = 'LEFT'
            elif dc > 0: direction = 'RIGHT'
            adj_info.append((other['color'], other['pixels'], direction))
    print(f"Adjacencies: {adj_info}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
